setup.skills_note: skills_read = published app skills the agent opened in that task. skill_assisted = the subset with a rule written for an action or reading this task needs (our reading of each skill text); opening a skill whose rules do not apply to the task is not counted as assisted.

task.goal: Turn brightness to the max value.
task.final_summary: Screen brightness is now set to the maximum. In Settings > Display, the brightness slider reads its top value (65535 of 65535) and the Brightness level row shows 100%.

steps.note: Observe current screen, then open Settings to brightness
In Settings, open Display > Brightness level
Open Display settings and find Brightness level
Open Brightness level slider and set it to maximum
Drag brightness slider to far right and verify value max
Close brightness slider and confirm Brightness level shows 100%
